sections.label: The procession is interrupted
sections.detail: Horn chant and viola arch; violin dance enters halfway through the first bar. New players arrive at different phrase positions.

sections.label: Nine players, exchanged roles
sections.detail: The double bass enters with the bridge. Flute adopts chant while oboe and then horn inherit the dance.

sections.label: The wrong turn
sections.detail: Viola E-natural falls to E-flat. The altered second spreads through chant and dance; the bass descends and then reverses upward.

sections.label: The procession hurries
sections.detail: Flute and delayed violin hurry the chant. The dance head enters horn at48, double bass at49, cello at50; the low lines then continue differently.

sections.label: The procession changes its mind
sections.detail: Major-mode chant and dance coexist; the broad bridge also changes its third and leading note.

sections.label: Release
sections.detail: Different ascending and descending routes converge on the final two-beat D-major sonority.

pedagogy.characteristic_figure: A deadpan chant, an interrupting 3+3+2 dance, and a rising bridge trade places.

annotations.title: The procession is interrupted
annotations.text: A deadpan chant meets an interrupting dance. The rising bridge is a third idea.

annotations.title: Nine players, exchanged roles
annotations.text: The ninth player enters with a melody. Flute, oboe and horn trade their jobs.

annotations.title: The wrong turn
annotations.text: Hear the viola E turn to E-flat. That semitone changes both the chant and the dance.

annotations.title: The procession hurries
annotations.text: The chant hurries. Horn, bass and cello pursue the dance head one beat apart.

annotations.title: The procession changes its mind
annotations.text: The same ideas acquire F-sharp and C-sharp: the procession changes its mind.

annotations.title: Release
annotations.text: The lines take different routes to one brief final arrival.

borrowed_material.source: GregoBase, Vatican version, Graduale Romanum1908 p83*
borrowed_material.treatment: New measured rhythm, register, modal variants and developments; the two other phrase families are original.

composition_record.language: D-centered minor/Dorian field; explicit E-flat turn; eventual D-major release. Dissonance, crossings, and brief parallel gestures are deliberate possibilities, not prohibited wholesale.
composition_record.status: Unheard audition paragraph, not a completed fugue or proof of nine-part musical success.
composition_record.evaluation: Thematic audibility, competing rhythmic attractions, clarity of the E-flat turn, necessity of the low delayed entries, and the earned character of the major release require listening.
